title: Phool’s Line Multiplies and a New Episode Opens

blocks.text: The concluding movement of this episode ties Kala's service and Bhai Bhagtu's intercession to the prosperity that now unfolds through Baba Mohan's descendants. The Guru's concession is shown ripening into concrete lineage rather than remaining a beautiful but abstract promise.

That fulfillment is marked most directly in the family itself. Two sons were born in his family, and the narrative begins to identify the lines that will later branch into major Phulkian houses and political formations.

At the same time the book prepares another transition. Episode 167 emerges not as a break from the prior blessing, but as its visible historical consequence in children, households, and expanding authority.
